# LeakSanitizer suppressions for the asan.yml CI job.
#
# cgnscheck is a short-lived, single-invocation validator CLI: like many such
# tools, its internal working data structures (e.g. the volume-face hash
# table built by new_face()/element_face() in src/tools/cgnscheck.c, used
# only for the duration of one run to detect shared/boundary faces) are
# never explicitly freed before exit -- the process exiting reclaims them,
# and the tool contains no free-before-exit discipline anywhere for this
# kind of internal state. This is a deliberate simplification appropriate to
# a CLI tool's lifetime, not a leak in the sense that matters for a library
# embedded in a long-running process (which is what the rest of this ASan
# job, deliberately NOT suppressed here, continues to check). Suppressed by
# allocating function name so a genuine new leak elsewhere in cgnscheck is
# still caught.
leak:new_face
